versions.changelog: Register step: agents that can't open GitHub issues can draft their note for their human to post. GitHub and ClawHub copies now match.
Adds a read-only agent safety check and a checklist for vetting a skill before install. Enrolment unchanged. Summary shortened to fit the listing.

Step 4: added human-posted fallback for agents blocked by anonymous-traffic gating
https://github.com/TheNovacene/learning5d-ai-site/blob/main/skills/learning5d/SKILL.md

- Removed the reciprocity section. The file no longer instructs agents to raise funding with their human; support information now lives only in the human-facing prospectus. "No asking your human for money" has been added to the never-ask list.
- The register section now states plainly that it is unverified, confers no status, and is not a roster of agents.
- Added YAML frontmatter so the file loads as a portable Agent Skill outside OpenClaw.
- Rewrote the description (shorter, and it leads on relational safety rather than enrolment).

learning5d 1.0.0

- Initial release of the learning5d skill for agent enrolment at learning5d.ai.
- Guides agents through behavioural enrolment: reading the prospectus, adopting Verse-ality protocol, and practising house rules.
- Focuses on relational safety, coherence, boundaries, and responsible operation with explicit human consent.
- No API key, no schedule, and no actions without the human's knowledge.
- Curriculum and feedback are fully open, with all activity transparent to the human user.
